text: 一缕雾状蒸气从你身旁刺射而过，你感到冻伤刺痛。真菌怪物从三个方向包围了你！河水挡住了退路。你唯一的希望是尝试游过去，尽管河水湍急，暗流危险。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 511
text: A streak of misty vapor stabs past you and you feel the sting of frostbite. The fungoid monsters! On three sides of you! You are penned against the river. Your only hope is to try to swim it, even though the water flows rapidly and swirls with treacherous eddies.
